> simulation back to a marker or specified point in the trajectory rather than

Such a functionality would allow entities to jump forward too, and the
name 'rollback' wouldn't make sense anymore. It could make sense to
add this as a new pair of activities (marker-jump, for example). But
unless there is a reasonable use case that cannot be reasonably solved
with the current set of activities, I wouldn't consider its
implementation.
